    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">零基础认识大语言模型（LLM）工作原理(13.Memory：从 RAG 到 AI Brain，Agent 如何拥有长期认知能力？)</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1g43zc4" data-start="322" data-end="369">第十三章 Memory：从 RAG 到 AI Brain，Agent 如何拥有长期认知能力</h1>
<hr data-start="371" data-end="374">
<h2 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633">目录</h2>
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633"><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/GuZhenYin/p/20983335">零基础认识大语言模型（LLM）工作原理目录 - GuZhenYin - 博客园</a></p>
<h1 data-section-id="1mmd8h9" data-start="376" data-end="382">本章导读</h1>
<p data-start="384" data-end="402">上一章我们介绍了 Workflow。</p>
<p data-start="404" data-end="409">我们知道了</p>
<p data-section-id="dl2yt2" data-start="411" data-end="436">MCP 解决了 Agent 如何连接外部能力</p>
<p data-section-id="yy4213" data-start="437" data-end="467">Workflow 解决了 Agent 如何组织复杂流程</p>
<p data-start="469" data-end="501">但是，一个真正长期工作的 AI 助手，还缺少一个非常重要的能力：<strong data-start="505" data-end="519">它必须能够积累经验。</strong></p>
<p data-start="521" data-end="526">想象一下：</p>
<p data-start="528" data-end="556">如果一个程序员助手每天早上启动后，都忘记昨天看过的代码。</p>
<p data-start="558" data-end="589">如果一个企业 AI 每次面对客户问题，都不知道过去的处理记录。</p>
<p data-start="591" data-end="618">如果一个销售 Agent 不知道过去和客户沟通过什么。</p>
<p data-start="620" data-end="643">那么它只能永远像一个“刚入职第一天的新员工”。</p>
<p data-start="645" data-end="648">因此：<strong data-start="652" data-end="694">没有 Memory 的 Agent，只是一个会思考但没有经历的 Agent。</strong></p>
<hr data-start="696" data-end="699">
<h1 data-section-id="1vg4xn7" data-start="701" data-end="722">13.1 LLM 为什么天生没有记忆？</h1>
<p data-start="724" data-end="740">这里我们首先需要纠正一个常见误解</p>
<p data-start="742" data-end="748">很多人认为ChatGPT 为什么知道我之前说的话？</p>
<p data-start="774" data-end="780">是不是因为模型已经学习了我的聊天内容？</p>
<p data-start="800" data-end="803">其实并不是</p>
<p data-start="800" data-end="803">我们重新梳理一下模型的运行过程</p>
<p data-start="815" data-end="825">大语言模型运行过程：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>用户输入
↓
Tokenizer
↓
Transformer
↓
预测下一个 Token
↓
输出结果</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="900" data-end="908">可以看出来,模型本身只拥有：<strong>参数记忆（Parametric Memory）</strong></p>
<p data-start="938" data-end="942">也就是说,它只拥有训练阶段学习到的知识。</p>
<p data-start="957" data-end="960">比如：</p>
<p data-start="962" data-end="967">模型知道：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1"><code>HTTP 是网络协议</code></div>
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1"><code>Python 是编程语言。</code></div>
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1"><code></code><code>地球绕太阳运行。</code></div>
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>因为这些知识<strong>存在在模型参数里面</strong>。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<hr data-start="1031" data-end="1034">
<p data-start="1036" data-end="1039">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-start="1036" data-end="1039">但是,你的个人信息,比如：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1"><code>我的项目使用 ABP。</code></div>
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1"><code></code><code>我的数据库是 MySQL。</code></div>
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1"><code></code><code>我的代码规范是 DDD。</code></div>
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1"><code></code><code>我的团队成员有哪些。</code></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>这些则不会自动进入模型参数。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1127" data-end="1130">因为模型不会也不可能,因为一次聊天重新训练。</p>
<p data-start="1154" data-end="1157">所以,LLM 更像一本训练完成的百科全书。</p>
<p data-start="1184" data-end="1188">而不是一个认识你的私人助手。</p>
<hr data-start="1205" data-end="1208">
<h1 data-section-id="o4kkfz" data-start="1210" data-end="1238">13.2 Agent 为什么必须拥有 Memory？</h1>
<p data-start="1240" data-end="1253">因为现实任务不是一次性的。</p>
<p data-start="1255" data-end="1258">比如用户说:</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;<code>帮我优化订单系统。</code></div>
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;一个普通 LLM可能会回答：</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;<code>可以考虑缓存、消息队列、数据库优化。</code></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;这就结束了。</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1334" data-end="1347">但是一个真正 Agent(智能体),它应该知道：&nbsp;</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>这个项目去年已经改过一次。
订单系统使用 Spring Boot。
数据库是 MySQL。
之前出现过库存一致性问题。
团队倾向使用 Outbox Pattern。</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1452" data-end="1457">然后应该给出结合历史背景的方案。</p>
<hr data-start="1471" data-end="1474">
<p data-start="1476" data-end="1479">区别就在于普通 LLM只能<strong><code>根据通用知识回答。</code></strong></p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div>&nbsp;而Agent(智能体)则可以<strong><code>根据世界知识 + 个人经验回答。</code></strong></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1509" data-end="1515">&nbsp;这,其实就是 Memory 的价值。</p>
<hr data-start="1560" data-end="1563">
<h1 data-section-id="98edi4" data-start="1565" data-end="1593">13.3 AI Memory 并不是“记住聊天记录”</h1>
<p data-start="1595" data-end="1603">很多人认为,Memory 其实等于保存聊天记录。</p>
<p data-start="1623" data-end="1636">简单这么理解,倒是没问题,但是实际上这是非常低级和早期的实现。</p>
<p data-start="1638" data-end="1641">比如保存下面这些信息,</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>用户：
你好。

AI：
你好。

用户：
今天怎么样？</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>这些信息价值非常低,完全没有实际意义。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1698" data-end="1706">而真正有价值的信息,应该是从大量人与AI的交互中提炼出来的：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>用户偏好
项目背景
业务规则
历史决策
经验总结
重要事实</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1763" data-end="1766">所以Memory 的目标并不是全部的保存过去。</p>
<p data-start="1792" data-end="1795">而是<strong>提取过去有价值的信息，帮助未来决策。</strong></p>
<hr data-start="1819" data-end="1822">
<h1 data-section-id="1125hni" data-start="1824" data-end="1849">13.4 Agent Memory 的三层结构</h1>
<p data-start="1851" data-end="1871">现代 Agent 系统通常可以分成三层。(当然,每个Agent 可能实现方式都有所不同)</p>
<h1 data-section-id="1yk9vg3" data-start="1878" data-end="1906">第一层：Session Context（会话上下文）</h1>
<p data-start="1908" data-end="1917">这是最基础的记忆。</p>
<p data-start="1919" data-end="1922">比如,当前聊天：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>用户：
帮我修改登录接口。

AI：
好的。

用户：
增加 OAuth 支持。</code>&nbsp;</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1981" data-end="1987">这时候,AI 知道：“增加 OAuth”指刚才那个登录接口。</p>
<p data-start="2011" data-end="2014">原因是历史消息仍然在 Context(对话上下文)中。</p>
<hr data-start="2036" data-end="2039">
<p data-start="2041" data-end="2044">但是,它存在明显限制。</p>
<p data-start="2055" data-end="2058">因为Context 窗口有大小限制。</p>
<p data-start="2083" data-end="2099">几十万 Token 甚至发展到现在百万级Token的上下文, 它始终也不是无限的。</p>
<p data-start="2106" data-end="2109">所以这个时候,我们就需要第二层了。</p>
<hr data-start="2119" data-end="2122">
<h1 data-section-id="159girp" data-start="2124" data-end="2149">第二层：Agent Memory（智能体记忆）</h1>
<p data-start="2151" data-end="2154">它负责保存Agent 工作过程中经常使用的信息。</p>
<p data-start="2177" data-end="2180">比如,用户偏好：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>喜欢 C#
喜欢 Markdown 文档
喜欢代码带注释</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2229" data-end="2234">当前任务的运行状态：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>当前任务进行到第三步
已经调用 Git 工具</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2269" data-end="2274">这些都属于Agent 自己的运行记忆。</p>
<hr data-start="2292" data-end="2295">
<h1 data-section-id="bphjjt" data-start="2297" data-end="2316">第三层：Brain（长期知识大脑）</h1>
<p data-start="2318" data-end="2338">这是未来 Agent 最重要的发展方向。(2026年新方向)</p>
<p data-start="2340" data-end="2343">它负责则整理和保存知识图谱：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>人物关系
企业信息
项目历史
业务知识
技术方案
会议记录
经验总结</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2395" data-end="2403">它不是简单存储。</p>
<p data-start="2405" data-end="2410">而是形成一个持续成长的知识体系。</p>
<hr data-start="2426" data-end="2429">
<p data-start="2431" data-end="2436">三者的关系我们可以简单归纳成下面这样：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>          Brain 个人长期知识图谱
                  ↑
          Agent Memory 工作状态和个人偏好
                  ↑
　　　　 Session Context 当前对话</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<hr data-start="2925" data-end="2928">
<h1 data-section-id="6pabgk" data-start="2930" data-end="2963">13.5 Vector Database(向量数据库)：传统搜索为什么不够？</h1>
<p data-start="2965" data-end="2971">既然我们需要保存Agent Memory(记忆),那么我们自然就碰到几个问题,如何本地存储?如何检索?</p>
<p data-start="2965" data-end="2971">假设我们的知识库中有下面这些信息：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>MySQL连接池异常分析
Redis锁设计方案
RabbitMQ消费优化
库存同步方案</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3029" data-end="3033">但是用户提问：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>为什么数据库空闲后第一次访问很慢？</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3062" data-end="3066">这里面的关键词没有“连接池”。</p>
<p data-start="3081" data-end="3086">但是语义接近：<code>MySQL连接池异常分析</code></p>
<hr data-start="3115" data-end="3118">
<p data-start="3120" data-end="3127">我们如果用传统的数据库+ SQL,只能写类似下面的语句：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>where content like '%连接池%'</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3165" data-end="3171">那大概率就找不到相关信息了.</p>
<hr data-start="3173" data-end="3176">向量数据库,则支持向量检索,它寻找的是<strong><code>距离最近的语义向量</code></strong>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div>那么我们就能找到相关信息了。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3221" data-end="3225">其实这就是之前我们提到过的 RAG基础检索。</p>
<p data-start="3221" data-end="3225">但是RAG也有自己的局限性.</p>
<hr data-start="3574" data-end="3577">
<h1 data-section-id="rn73s7" data-start="3579" data-end="3606">13.6 RAG 的局限：它只是搜索，不是真正理解</h1>
<p data-start="3608" data-end="3611">假定我们的知识中存在：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>张三负责 SPD 项目。
SPD 项目采用 Outbox。
Outbox 用于解决消息一致性。</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>人类马上可以理解：</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3686" data-end="3689">这些信息的关系：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>张三
↓
SPD
↓
Outbox
↓
消息一致性</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>但是普通 Vector Search(向量检索)：</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3753" data-end="3764">只是找到几个相关文本。</p>
<p data-start="3766" data-end="3771">它并不知道实体之间关系。</p>
<p data-start="3787" data-end="3791">这就是Knowledge Graph（知识图谱）出现的原因。</p>
<hr data-start="3824" data-end="3827">
<h1 data-section-id="hdzj3v" data-start="3829" data-end="3861">13.7 Knowledge Graph：让 AI 理解关系</h1>
<p data-start="3863" data-end="3868">知识图谱的核心结构主要就是：<strong><code>实体</code><code>+</code><code>关系</code><code>+</code><code>属性</code></strong></p>
<p data-start="3903" data-end="3906">比如：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>张三 --负责--&gt; SPD系统
SPD系统 --采用--&gt; Outbox Pattern
Outbox Pattern --解决--&gt; 消息一致性</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;这就构成了一个完整的知识图谱,比单纯文本更接近人类认知方式。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<hr data-start="4023" data-end="4026">
<h1 data-section-id="1kbzib7" data-start="4028" data-end="4063">13.8 从 Memory 到 Brain：GBrain 的启发</h1>
<p data-start="4065" data-end="4089">GBrain是由 garrytan 最近的<strong>开源个人知识管理系统.</strong></p>
<p data-start="4065" data-end="4089">其实到这时候，我们可以理解 GBrain 代表的方向。</p>
<p data-start="4091" data-end="4106">GBrain 的定位不是简单“聊天记录存储”。</p>
<p data-start="4119" data-end="4122">而是<strong>为 Agent 构建一个长期知识大脑。</strong></p>
<p data-start="4147" data-end="4151">它强调：</p>
<ul data-start="4153" data-end="4192">
<li data-section-id="105jz6h" data-start="4153" data-end="4160">知识沉淀；</li>
<li data-section-id="2d9nsm" data-start="4161" data-end="4168">实体关系；</li>
<li data-section-id="1alv6em" data-start="4169" data-end="4176">混合检索；</li>
<li data-section-id="r7iysp" data-start="4177" data-end="4184">信息综合；</li>
<li data-section-id="uwfuk6" data-start="4185" data-end="4192">持续维护。</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="4194" data-end="4326">GBrain 项目作者将其定位为 Agent 的 Brain Layer，用于连接 OpenClaw、Hermes 等 Agent，并通过知识页面、关系连接、混合检索等方式形成长期知识体系。</p>
<hr data-start="4328" data-end="4331">
<p data-start="4333" data-end="4340">传统 RAG：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>问题
↓
搜索几个文本片段
↓
回答</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="4374" data-end="4377">更像搜索引擎。</p>
<hr data-start="4386" data-end="4389">
<p data-start="4391" data-end="4397">Brain则是：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>信息输入
↓
知识整理
↓
实体关联
↓
持续更新
↓
综合推理</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>就更像人的长期记忆。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<hr data-start="4463" data-end="4466">
<h1 data-section-id="dk9k7g" data-start="4468" data-end="4500">13.9 GBrain 的核心思想：知识不是存储，而是演化</h1>
<p data-start="4502" data-end="4508">传统RAG知识库：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>上传文档
↓
建立索引
↓
查询</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="4540" data-end="4543">问题就在于知识,它不会成长。</p>
<hr data-start="4554" data-end="4557">
<p data-start="4559" data-end="4565">Brain则是：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>获取信息
↓
分析
↓
建立关系
↓
发现冲突
↓
更新认知</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="4615" data-end="4618">比如,</p>
<p data-start="4615" data-end="4618">一月份:<code>医院 A 使用 SPD 版本 V2</code></p>
<p data-start="4652" data-end="4655">二月份:<code>医院 A 升级 V3</code></p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div>Brain 则应该知道：</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="4690" data-end="4698">旧信息已经变化。</p>
<p data-start="4700" data-end="4712">而不是两个答案同时存在。</p>
<hr data-start="4714" data-end="4717">
<p data-start="4719" data-end="4723">这也是AI Agent 与普通搜索系统最大的区别。</p>
<hr data-start="4749" data-end="4752">
<h1 data-section-id="mkli7m" data-start="4754" data-end="4776">13.10 企业 Agent 的未来架构</h1>
<p data-start="4778" data-end="4786">到这里,我们可以大胆猜测一下.未来的企业 AI的记忆体：</p>
<p data-start="4788" data-end="4793">它不会只是<strong><code>LLM</code><code>+</code><code>RAG</code></strong></p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div>而是会演变成：</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>                 Agent

                    |

              Brain Layer

        ---------------------

        文档

        项目

        人员

        业务规则

        历史决策

        ---------------------

              Knowledge Graph

                    |

            Vector + Search</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<hr data-start="5114" data-end="5117">
<p data-start="5119" data-end="5122">比如医院 SPD Agent：</p>
<p data-start="5139" data-end="5142">用户：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>为什么这个医院今天同步失败？</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="5168" data-end="5174">它应该知道：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>医院
↓
SPD版本
↓
接口变化
↓
历史Bug
↓
解决方案
↓
负责人</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>最终给出的不是“搜索结果”。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="5253" data-end="5256">而是一个结合历史经验的判断。</p>
<hr data-start="5272" data-end="5275">
<h1 data-section-id="wgkni5" data-start="5277" data-end="5302">13.11 对未来 Agent 的大胆预测</h1>
<p data-start="5304" data-end="5314">我们可以大胆预测一下,未来 AI 的竞争不会只是谁的模型参数更多。</p>
<p data-start="5331" data-end="5344">因为世界知识有限,各个模型其实基本都快吃透(训练)了,模型的能力只会越来越接近。</p>
<p data-start="5346" data-end="5355">真正产生差异的其实是,<strong>Agent 是否拥有属于自己的 Brain(大脑)。</strong></p>
<p data-start="5383" data-end="5403">同一个 GPT、Claude、Qwen,连接或者使用不同 Brain。</p>
<p data-start="5418" data-end="5425">表现其实可能就会完全不同。</p>
<hr data-start="5492" data-end="5495">
<h1 data-section-id="1mm2zvm" data-start="5497" data-end="5503">本章总结</h1>
<p data-start="5505" data-end="5527">这一章，我们重新理解了 AI Memory。</p>
<p data-start="5529" data-end="5534">我们明确了以下核心观点：</p>
<p data-section-id="1mo196" data-start="5541" data-end="5546">1.LLM 本身没有长期记忆。它只有训练得到的参数知识。</p>
<p data-section-id="1mo1dl" data-start="5583" data-end="5588">2.Agent Memory 不是保存聊天记录。而是管理有价值的信息。</p>
<p data-section-id="1mo1aw" data-start="5632" data-end="5637">3.RAG 解决：“找到相关资料”。</p>
<p data-section-id="1mo18f" data-start="5664" data-end="5669">4.Knowledge Graph 解决：“理解信息关系”。</p>
<p data-section-id="1mo15q" data-start="5708" data-end="5713">5.AI Brain 解决：“让 Agent 持续积累认知”。</p>
<hr data-start="5748" data-end="5751">
<p data-start="5753" data-end="5762">最后用一句话总结：<strong data-start="5766" data-end="5823">LLM 负责推理，Tool 负责行动，Workflow 负责流程，而 Brain 负责让 AI 拥有过去。</strong></p>

</div>
